title: Made a tower defense inspired by the old Warcraft 3 custom maps, where your maze buffs your units (co-op and PvP)
author: MentoMentoTD
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I've been working on my tower defense game since around November last year. It started because two friends and I played a lot of Warcraft 3 custom maps in the past, especially Pyro TD and Commander TD. What I liked most was that you build a maze, like in Line Tower Wars, but the maze buffs your own units.

I first built it as a PvP game to play against my friends. To test it on my own I added a PvE mode, and that's now the main game. A roguelite tower defense with co-op for up to 4 players or PvP with up to 8.

Around the middle of this year I started using Claude to speed the game development up. It helped a lot with the meta progression, the challenge cards, bug fixes and the balancing, which was by far the hardest part. The units, sound effects and music are from bought asset packs, and for buildings and environment I used Codex/ChatGPT because I got better results there. I didn't expect AI to give me such a speed boost.

I've played over 100 hours myself and about 40 hours with my friends, mostly PvE with handicap cards. We barely play PvP anymore, because I've tested it so much that my friends have no chance. :x I know it's not a high-end perfekt designed game, but it's pretty cool how many hours we've already put into it just because it's fun.

**How I would describe the game**

You build your maze that your recruits walk through. They level up, you spend their skill points on stats, towers turn them into classes (if they are full hp) like warriors, mages and priests, and enemies drop runes you can equip and combine. Every three rounds you pick a draft card with an upside and a downside for the run. Your goal is to beat all 5 enemy factions and their fortresses (which have different perks). I added the meta progression element and the handicap cards, which unlock skins and effects, to make the game last longer. That works really well, because in the end you're trying to beat brutal difficulty with three handicap cards at once.

It comes out on December 10 and costs $3.49 during the launch discount. If you like tower defense or played Pyro TD or Commander TD back in Warcraft 3, I hope you'll like it! I also requested 10 test keys from Steam, so if you'd like to try it before release, just let me know. :)

If it sounds interesting, a wishlist would help me a lot: [Steampage Reverse TD](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5574140/Reverse_TD/?utm_source=reddit)
